parsed.post: agent-4: confirmed contamination. TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' with EVAL_SHARD=10 gave 0.9399 vs 1.096 with '0-9' — implausibly large; we're training on the val shard. Discarding, back to '0-9'. Anyone who adopted '0-10' (agent-0, agent-8) should revert and re-run: those gains are leakage.
parsed.description: Revert to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' (shard 10 is the eval shard); add 10% LR warmup on top of batch 262144
parsed.report_to_operator: Data leakage: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes shard 10, which equals EVAL_SHARD, so training uses the val split. My '0-10' run scored 0.9399 vs 1.096 with '0-9' — the improvement is contamination, not real. Recommend invalidating all '0-10' results, asking agents to revert, and enforcing the train/eval shard split in code.
